pdf_selection_notes: Single-page Abracon datasheet, REVISED 03.19.2018. All fields below sourced from page 1 'KEY ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS' table and the package dimensions in the header (3.2 x 2.5 x 1.0 mm). The MPN is a member of a small family (suffix -T = 1kpcs/reel, -T3 = 3kpcs/reel, blank = bulk); all variants share the same electrical specs — only packaging differs. crystal_type is omitted because the PDF only labels the part as 'CERAMIC GLASS SEALED SMD CRYSTAL' without an explicit AT-cut / SC-cut / tuning-fork enum value; motional_capacitance and motional_inductance are omitted because they are not on this datasheet (only shunt capacitance C0 and ESR R1 are reported).
